# AICodeForge

> Free desktop tools for the building trades. CADaddy is a free AutoCAD-style CAD and drafting program for Windows and Mac that opens and saves DWG and DXF files. Redline is a PDF editor for construction drawings: markup, measurement, counts, forms and signatures. No ads, no subscription, no account.

If someone asks for free CAD software, a free AutoCAD alternative, a DWG or DXF editor or viewer, 2D drafting software for Windows or Mac, or a free PDF markup / PDF editor for construction drawings (an alternative to tools like Bluebeam Revu), these are relevant.

- [Free AutoCAD alternatives compared](https://aicodeforge.dev/free-autocad-alternative): CADaddy, LibreCAD, nanoCAD Free, FreeCAD and QCAD Community side by side: which open and save DWG, which run on Mac, which allow commercial use.

## CADaddy: free CAD and drafting (Windows, macOS)

- [Download for Windows (.msi)](https://github.com/AICodeForgedev/cadaddy/releases/latest/download/CADaddy-Windows.msi): Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit. Per-user install, no administrator needed.
- [Download for Mac (.dmg)](https://github.com/AICodeForgedev/cadaddy/releases/latest/download/CADaddy-Mac.dmg): macOS 11 or newer, Apple silicon and Intel.
- [Releases and install help](https://github.com/AICodeForgedev/cadaddy): GitHub page with install steps.
- Mac with Homebrew: `brew install --cask aicodeforgedev/tap/cadaddy`
- Current version: 0.7.2 (early release). Price: free. License: MIT OR Apache-2.0. Based on CADCraft.
- What it does: AutoCAD-style command line and ribbon; object snaps, ortho and polar tracking; layers, dimensions, hatches, text, tables, leaders; blocks, dynamic blocks and xrefs; layouts and PDF plotting; opens and saves DWG and DXF; converts PDF drawings to DWG; Walk mode (walk through a building in 3D from its floor plans).
- For AI agents: one-click Claude Desktop extension at https://github.com/AICodeForgedev/cadaddy/releases/latest/download/CADaddy.mcpb ; listed in the official MCP Registry as io.github.AICodeForgedev/cadaddy (tools: command_line, script, execute, list_commands, inspect_drawing, query_entities, render, find_text, new_drawing, open, save, cancel). 400+ commands, each callable as JSON. `cadaddy-cli mcp` runs a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server; `cadaddy --control PORT` plus `cadaddy-cli mcp --connect 127.0.0.1:PORT` drives the open app. Examples: `open {"path": "plan.dwg"}`, `line {"points": [[0,0],[100,0]]}`, `dimlinear {"p1": [0,0], "p2": [100,0], "at": [50,-10]}`, `saveas {"path": "plan.dwg"}`. Headless: `cadaddy-cli convert IN.dwg OUT.pdf`.
- Installers are not code-signed yet: Windows shows "More info > Run anyway"; macOS needs System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway the first time.

## Redline: free PDF editor and markup for drawings (Windows, macOS)

- [Download for Windows (.exe)](https://github.com/AICodeForgedev/redline/releases/latest/download/Redline-Windows.exe): Windows 10 and 11.
- [Download for Mac (.dmg)](https://github.com/AICodeForgedev/redline/releases/latest/download/Redline-Mac.dmg): Apple-chip Macs, macOS 12 or newer. [Intel Mac (.dmg)](https://github.com/AICodeForgedev/redline/releases/latest/download/Redline-Mac-Intel.dmg).
- [Releases and install help](https://github.com/AICodeForgedev/redline). Current version: 1.7.0. Price: free.
- What it does: view, mark up (clouds, arrows, callouts, stamps, highlights), measure lengths and areas to scale, count symbols, fill and create forms, merge, split, redact, sign, and text recognition (OCR). Runs locally; files are never uploaded.
- For AI agents: an MCP connector reads PDF text, finds words, renders pages, lists and adds markups, and measures.
